text:
Lina (Sales): Quick sync: EuroBank wants an EU-only POC for their compliance review. They need a sub-processor inventory + an "EU-DataGuard" style attestation, strict routing so traffic never leaves EU, and a ballpark POC price for ~2M tokens/month. Can we map options and ETA? cc @Diego @Nina
Diego (Solutions Eng): A couple of clarifying items: 1) BYOK required for the POC? 2) Do they need VPC/private deployment or is hosted with strict geofencing OK? Also need target SLOs for latency.
Marie (Customer Sec Ops): No BYOK for POC, keep it simple. Must be EU data residency with attestable subproc list. Latency SLA: 95th < 350ms for single-turn is our target. Also request SOC2 artifacts and 120-day audit log retention during the POC.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Understood. We can offer three flavors: hosted geofence (quickest), Dedicated EU pool (reserved GPUs in-region with stronger isolation), Private VPC (most effort but fully controllable). Tradeoffs: hosted is fast but control plane signals may be outside EU; we can pseudonymize/control telemetry. Dedicated gives better SLA and isolation. Private is certifiable for audits.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Example strict routing policy we'll propose:
```
routing:
  tenant: eurobank-poc
  residency: EU
  region_preference: [eu-central-1, eu-west-1]
  failover_policy: regional_strict   # do not route outside EU
  subprocessor_whitelist: ["aws:eu-central-1","azure:westeurope","gcp:europe-west1"]
```
Diego (Solutions Eng): Ops note: regional_strict disables cross-border fallthrough; this reduces global capacity headroom and increases risk of degraded service if EU pools saturate. We'll include a canary that pins to EU-only model variant during the POC.
Nina (Infra): For hosted geofence we host data plane in eu-central/eu-west edge-zones. Control plane signaling includes only non-sensitive metadata and we can enable telemetry pseudonymization/opt-out for this POC. I'll produce the network path and cert bundle. Also note: edge zone eu-north-1 may be included if they want extra redundancy.
Arjun (Legal): I can draft the attestation ("EU-DataGuard" short letter) once Infra confirms the active subprocessor list. Timing: I can do 2 business days after infra confirms. Will include DPA reference + export controls.
Ravi (Pricing): Rough POC pricing (2M tokens/month baseline): hosted geofence = $1,050/mo; dedicated reserved (6mo commit) = $600/mo; private VPC = $7,500 one-time setup + $520/mo infra bill. These are preliminary and assume Llama-2 13B quant, 10rps peak. Any SOC2/artifact access or extended log retention will add a fee.
Lina (Sales): @Ravi please convert to a quick formal quote. Customer asked for a 48-72h turnaround on the attestation + subproc list. @Nina can infra meet that?
Nina (Infra): I'll gather and validate subproc inventory and upload the network diagram + certs to the handoff by EOD today: https://redwood.internal/handbooks/eurobank-poc. I'll also publish a short runbook note about egress cost triggers if any cross-zone transfers happen.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Quick sample API call we'll include in the playbook to pin tenant to a region:
```
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant":"eurobank","assign_region":"eu-central-1","policy":"regional_strict"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/assign_region
```
Marie (Customer Sec Ops): Please also include an ingress/egress diagram and confirmation that audit logs will be stored in-region for 120 days.
Arjun (Legal): Noted. Once infra confirms subproc list I'll push the attestation draft. Will include language on log retention and SOC2 artifact access.
Ravi (Pricing): Pricing ops note: if they want ISO artifacts and extended log retention past 90 days, I'll add a compliance surcharge. Call out exact retention to estimate.
Lina (Sales): Proposed timeline: infra subproc + netdiag EOD today; pricing draft EOD tomorrow; legal attestation in 2 business days after infra upload; playbook + perf baseline by Diego EOD tomorrow. POC kickoff target next Wed. Everyone ok?
Diego (Solutions Eng): I'm good. I'll produce a 1-page POC playbook with perf test script and include measured 95th latency numbers from a small run.
Nina (Infra): Uploaded: https://redwood.internal/handbooks/eurobank-poc/netdiag.pdf and certs bundle. Subproc list attached in the folder.
Ravi (Pricing): I'll send the formal quote and note the compliance surcharge scenarios by EOD tomorrow.
Arjun (Legal): I'll start the attestation draft and loop security for review. Two business days estimated.
Marie (Customer Sec Ops): Thanks all. Please mark the playbook with a POC SLA section and include the 95th < 350ms target. Also provide a fallback explanation if regional pools saturate.
